source.title: Satrana - Ember Enchantress
source.name: Satrana
source.description: A Keeper of Flames who can sustain tremendous damage, reduce enemy's Vitality, and deal continuous damage.

skills.name: Fiery Dance

description.raw: Satrana does the fiery dance, dealing 240% (ATK-based) damage to surrounding enemies within 2 tiles. She is invincible during the effect.
active: Satrana does the fiery dance, dealing 240% (ATK-based) damage to surrounding enemies within 2 tiles.
She is invincible during the effect.

text: The last strike of this skill charms enemies for 2 + 0.25 (SP-based)s, making them only use normal attacks while charmed.

skills.description_lite: Satrana deals continuous damage to enemies and is invincible during the effect.

skills.name: Vixen Rush

description.raw: Satrana scratches enemies in a 1-tile arc twice. Each strike deals 110% (ATK-based) damage plus 2.5% + 0.5% (SP-based) target's max HP. The additional damage cannot exceed 75% + 10% (SP-based) of Satrana's ATK. The damage dealt by this skill grants Satrana 100 Life Drain.
active: Satrana scratches enemies in a 1-tile arc twice.
Each strike deals 110% (ATK-based) damage plus 2.5% + 0.5% (SP-based) target's max HP.
The additional damage cannot exceed 75% + 10% (SP-based) of Satrana's ATK.
The damage dealt by this skill grants Satrana 100 Life Drain.

skills.description_lite: Satrana attacks enemies within the radius of an arc and gains Life Drain.

skills.name: Ignite Passions

description.raw: Satrana grants Sparks to allies within 2 tiles when a battle starts. When Satrana or allies with Sparks deal damage to an enemy for 3 times, the target is burned, taking damage equal to 0.8% + 0.2% (SP-based) of max HP every 1s and reducing their Vitality by 20. The skill damage cannot exceed 45% + 5% (SP-based) of Satrana's ATK. The effect lasts until the battle ends.
active: Satrana grants Sparks to allies within 2 tiles when a battle starts.
When Satrana or allies with Sparks deal damage to an enemy for 3 times, the target is burned, taking damage equal to 0.8% + 0.2% (SP-based) of max HP every 1s and reducing their Vitality by 20.
The skill damage cannot exceed 45% + 5% (SP-based) of Satrana's ATK.
The effect lasts until the battle ends.

text: When all enemies or a total of 5 enemies have been ignited, the Vitality reduction is increased to 60.
Increases damage to 1% + 0.2% (SP-based) of the target's max HP.
When all enemy heroes or 5 enemy heroes have been ignited, the damage is increased to 2% of max HP.

skills.description_lite: Satrana or allies with Sparks ignite enemies, reducing their Vitality and dealing continuous damage to them.

description.raw: Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.
active: Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.

text: Reduces damage taken by 16% during battle.
Reduces damage taken by 20% during battle.

skills.name: Radiant Vigor

description.raw: When an enemy hero is ignited, the magic damage taken by Satrana is reduced by 16% until the battle ends. Satrana grants this effect to a nearby ally when one more enemy hero is ignited.
active: When an enemy hero is ignited, the magic damage taken by Satrana is reduced by 16% until the battle ends.
Satrana grants this effect to a nearby ally when one more enemy hero is ignited.

text: Each ignited enemy hero grants Satrana 200 Energy.
Increases Satrana's magic DMG Reduction to 20%.
Increases Satrana's magic DMG Reduction to 22%.

skills.description_lite: Satrana ignites enemies, causing her and her allies to take less magic damage.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Vixen Rush's cooldown is removed when all enemy heroes are ignited or when a total of 5 enemy heroes have been ignited.
active: Vixen Rush's cooldown is removed when all enemy heroes are ignited or when a total of 5 enemy heroes have been ignited.

skills.description_lite: Vixen Rush's cooldown is removed when all enemy heroes have been ignited.
